landing.hero_subtitle: Upload your lab report, prescription, or discharge instructions — and get a clear, simple explanation in plain language.
landing.feature_extract_desc: We pull out the important facts from your document — values, medications, and instructions.
landing.feature_explain_desc: Medical terms explained in simple English or Hindi, without inventing any facts.
landing.feature_checklist_desc: Convert written instructions into a checklist you can actually follow.
landing.feature_questions_desc: Walk into your next appointment with the right questions ready.
landing.disclaimer: MediClear is an educational tool. It is not a doctor, diagnostic system, or prescription generator. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice.
landing.step1_desc: Read our privacy notice and agree to how we handle your document.
landing.step2_desc: Supported formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG. Max 10 MB.
landing.step3_desc: Check and correct what was extracted before we explain it.
landing.step4_desc: Plain-language summary, medical terms, checklist, and doctor questions.

consent.title: Privacy & Consent
consent.subtitle: Please read and accept before we process your document.
consent.privacy_heading: What we do with your document
consent.privacy_body: Your document is processed on our server using Google's Gemini AI service to extract and explain its contents. We store only the minimum information needed to show you results. Your original file and all derived data are automatically deleted after 30 days, or sooner if you choose to delete them.
consent.ai_body: Document content is sent to Google's Gemini API for processing. We attempt to remove obvious personal identifiers before sending, but we cannot guarantee complete removal. Google's data handling policies apply. MediClear does not sell or share your data with third parties.
consent.limitation_body: MediClear is an educational document-understanding assistant. It does not diagnose diseases, recommend medications, or replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.
consent.emergency_note: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, stop and call your local emergency services immediately.
consent.checkbox_label: I have read and understood the above. I consent to my document being processed as described.

upload.title: Upload Your Document
upload.subtitle: Supported formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG · Max 10 MB
upload.helper_text: Supported: Lab reports, Prescriptions, Discharge instructions. PDF, JPG, PNG.
upload.try_demo: Try a demo (sample data, not your document)
upload.err_type: Unsupported file type. Please upload a PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
upload.err_size: File is too large. Maximum size is 10 MB.
upload.err_consent: Patient consent must be accepted first before uploading medical documents.
upload.err_server: Server unreachable. Please check your connection and try again.
upload.note: Note: Do not upload documents containing sensitive personal information belonging to others. For development testing, use synthetic or sample documents only.

processing.title: Processing Your Document
processing.error_body: We could not process your document. This may be due to a corrupted file, unsupported content, or a temporary error.
processing.unsupported_msg: This doesn't look like a lab report, prescription, or discharge instruction. MediClear can only explain these document types.
processing.unreadable_msg: The document is too blurry, dark, or corrupted. Please upload a clearer photo or PDF.
processing.not_configured_msg: The extraction service requires an active Gemini API key. Please configure GEMINI_API_KEY on the server.
processing.extraction_failed_msg: We were unable to extract clinical information from this document. Please try again.

extracted.title: Review Extracted Information
extracted.subtitle: Check the information we extracted. Correct any mistakes before we generate your explanation.
extracted.uncertainty_note: These items could not be extracted reliably. Please verify them in the original document.
extracted.edit_hint: Click any value to correct it.
extracted.demo_notice: Demo mode: Showing synthetic sample data.
extracted.empty_msg: No parameters could be extracted from this document. You can upload a clearer photo or try another document.
extracted.err_rejected: This document was rejected as unsupported or unreadable.

explanation.title: Your Document Explained
explanation.delete_confirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete the document and all generated content.
explanation.demo_notice: Demo mode: Showing synthetic sample data.
explanation.err_rejected: Cannot generate an explanation for a rejected document.
explanation.checklist_desc: Actionable tasks and health recommendations derived from this report.
explanation.questions_desc: Prepared questions to take to your next physician appointment.

checklist.title: Your Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Based on the instructions in your document.
checklist.empty: No checklist items were generated from this document.
checklist.demo_notice: Demo mode: Synthetic checklist items shown.
checklist.err_rejected: Cannot generate a checklist for a rejected document.

questions.title: Questions for Your Doctor
questions.subtitle: Take these questions to your next appointment.
questions.empty: No questions were generated from this document.
questions.demo_notice: Demo mode: Synthetic consultation questions shown.
questions.err_rejected: Cannot generate questions for a rejected document.

settings.title: Settings & Privacy
settings.data_body: Documents are automatically deleted after 30 days. You can delete a document and all its associated data at any time from the explanation page.
settings.disclaimer_body: MediClear is not a medical device, diagnostic tool, or substitute for professional medical advice. Information extracted and explained by MediClear should always be verified with a qualified healthcare professional.
settings.ai_provider_body: MediClear uses Google Gemini to extract and explain document content. Document data is sent to Google's servers for processing. For details, see Google's AI data handling policies.
